properties.name: SouthPlace City Center
properties.caption: BH Group, in partnership with Electra America, is developing the $1 billion-plus project on a portion of Cutler Bay's Southland Mall. Aside from renovating existing retail, the entire redevelopment is entitled for roughly 5,000 residential units in multiple new buildings, including the first phase's eight-story, 350-unit apartment building that's under construction. The project also is slated for a 150-key hotel, medical offices and additional retail on outparcels.

properties.name: Raffles Residences Coconut Grove
properties.caption: After BH Group and Mast Capital completed the $28 million bulk buyout of the 39-unit Bayshore Park condo building in Coconut Grove, they announced a new 35-unit condo under the Raffles Hotels & Resorts brand. Sales are expected to launch in the fall, with prices starting at $4.5 million. Toledano has described Coconut Grove as having a "very, very limited supply" of luxury condos.

properties.name: The Bradley
properties.caption: Long before Toledano built a public profile through a polished social media presence and real estate panel appearances, he was already building projects with the Pérez family’s Related Group. One of them was the seven-story, 175-unit The Bradley, completed in 2019 in Wynwood. The partners sold it in 2021, with the buyer rebranding the property as Sentral Wynwood.

properties.name: The Crosby
properties.caption: The Crosby is another project BH Group partnered on in the background, before the firm embraced the spotlight. BH, Related Group and Merrimac Ventures have completed and sold out the 33-story, 450-unit short-term rental friendly condo tower at Miami Worldcenter.

properties.name: Paraiso Bayviews
properties.caption: Paraiso Bayviews is one of several Paraiso towers Related Group completed in Edgewater in the late 2010s. BH Group was a partner in one of them, the 46-story, 388-unit Paraiso Bayviews.

properties.name: District 225
properties.caption: One of BH Group's most recently finished projects, again in partnership with Related Group, is the 37-story, 343-unit short-term rental friendly District 225 in downtown Miami. ROVR Development also was a partner on the project.

properties.name: The Residences at Six Fisher Island
properties.caption: BH Group, Related Group and Israeli billionaire Teddy Sagi — one of BH Group's frequent project investors — are developing the ultra-luxury 10-story, 50-units condo on Miami Beach's exclusive Fisher Island. Homes will average 4,800 square feet. The project has over $500 million in pre-sales.

properties.name: Wake Biscayne Bay
properties.caption: BH Group isn't entirely focused on ground-up development. Its portfolio includes several income-producing assets, including this bayfront North Bay Village apartment complex with three 10-story buildings with a total of 338 units. The firm paid $83 million for the property last year.

properties.name: North Beach hotel redevelopments
properties.caption: Toledano's business model is largely rooted in finding prime, yet overlooked, development sites and partnering on projects. In a nod to this playbook, BH Group is teaming up with Kolter Group on a redevelopment of a pair of oceanfront North Beach hotels, the Crystal Beach Suites Miami Oceanfront Resort and the adjacent Normandy Plaza Hotel, with a 37-unit condo. Most recently, the pair dropped $3.8 million for 10-units at the nearby Port Royale Condo.

properties.name: Miami Beach Club
properties.caption: BH Group, Related Group and Dezer Development want to redevelop the aging Miami Beach Club condo building with a 62-story, 145-unit condo tower. The partners completed the nearly $132 million buyout of the existing 108-unit building last year.

properties.name: Aventura City Center
properties.caption: For this mixed-use project, BH Group broke from its tradition of partnering with Related Group. This summer, BH Group and Apollo Companies bought out Related's stake in the development. The plan is for a roughly 250-unit apartment building with 10,000 square feet of retail for the first phase, and a 153-key Marriott hotel with 10,000 square feet of retail for the second phase. The office building on the site, which is BH's headquarters, will remain.

properties.name: Aventura ALF
properties.caption: BH Group has expanded its investment in assisted-living facilities, with three purchases of senior care centers. One of them was this 171-unit facility in Aventura, which BH bought at a 75 percent discount from the property's last sale price nine years ago. For its ALFs purchases, BH has been partnering with Gold Standard of Care, led by Michael Verbitsky, and rebranded the properties as AHAVA, bringing them under the management of Colonial Assisted Living.

properties.name: Greenview at Presidential Estates
properties.caption: BH Group and Lennar are redeveloping an over 100-acre golf course west of Aventura with 103 luxury single-family homes, completing the first phase with 30 homes and starting on the second phase, also with 30 homes. Prices start at roughly $2.5 million and go up to $3.5 million.

properties.name: Icon Beach Residences
properties.caption: BH Group and Related are developing the two-tower, 31-story Icon Beach Residences condo with 350 units, combined. This spring, the pair scored a $360 million construction loan from Adi Chugh's Tyko Capital.

properties.name: Diplomat Landings
properties.caption: Next to Icon Beach, BH Group and Related also have approval for a 42-story, 500-unit condo-hotel tower. This and Icon Beach are across the street from the 1,000-unit Diplomat Beach Resort, with the planned 500-unit condo-hotel expected to help with hosting large conventions.

properties.name: Lyfe Resort & Residences
properties.caption: This project marked the start of BH Group's yearslong partnership with Related Group. Completed in 2017, the 41-story tower has 407 condos. Edgardo Defortuna's Fortune International Group also was a development partner. The tower was previously branded as Hyde.

properties.name: Hollywood Beach Resort
properties.caption: BH Group and Related have the 398-unit Hollywood Beach Resort under contract for $100 million from the Chetrit Group. Most recently, Coconut Grove-based Terra, led by David Martin, joined talks to purchase and redevelop the century-old property.

properties.name: The Quay
properties.caption: In one of BH Group's few non-luxury residential projects, the firm has jumped on the Live Local Act bandwagon. BH, Related Group and Pebb Enterprises scored approval last year for the 33-story, 521-unit tower with 217 affordable and workforce apartments. It would rise on the site of a 7-acre shopping plaza with a marina.

properties.name: Plantation City Center
properties.caption: After purchasing the site for $13 million in 2023 and scoring redevelopment approval the following year, BH Group and Related this year sought to downsize the project amid a softer apartment market in South Florida. They now want to build 385 apartments, down by 25 percent from the previous proposal, as well as 12,100 square feet of retail.

properties.name: W Pompano Beach Hotel & Residences
properties.caption: BH Group and Related Group have started pre-selling units at the planned 24-story, project with 77 condos and 296 condo-hotel units.

properties.name: Ritz-Carlton Residences West Palm Beach
properties.caption: This was at least the second construction loan BH Group and Related Group scored this year for branded condos. On a site steps from the bay in West Palm Beach, the pair are developing the 27-story, 138-unit Ritz-Carlton Residences, which is at least 70 percent pre-sold.

properties.name: Rosewood Residences
properties.caption: This summer, BH Group and Related Group scored approval for their Rosewood-branded 27-story, 90-unit condo project steps from the bay in West Palm Beach.

properties.name: Site near WPB's Currie Park
properties.caption: In another partnership with Terra, BH Group is buying this 1.6-acre site near West Palm's Currie Park for about $100 million from Jeff Greene. BH and Terra plan a pair of 31-story towers with 281 condos, combined.

properties.name: Transit Village
properties.caption: The long-stalled redevelopment of a West Palm transit hub got new life in 2022, when BH Group, Related and Sagi partnered with the original developer, Michael Masanoff. The project is planned for four 25-story buildings with nearly 1,000 residential units and 108 hotel keys, as well as commercial space.

properties.name: The Eclipse
properties.caption: BH Group and Pebb Enterprises, led by Ian Weiner, are redeveloping this 29-acre office campus in Boca Raton, formerly known as Office Depot's headquarters. Aside from renovating two office buildings, they're replacing the third with a 500-unit apartment building in partnership with Related Group. BH and Pebb also are building retail on the outparcels, including an Equinox. Office Depot kept its HQ on site, while multiple other tenants have signed leases, including health care firm MDVIP.

properties.name: Boca Raton ALF
properties.caption: The BH Group-Gold Standard of Care partnership, which is focusing on assisted-living facilities, bought this 160-bed center last year at a discount of $10 million from its sale price eight years ago. Blackstone was the seller.

properties.name: Gallery at Marina Village
properties.caption: BH Group, Related Group and Tezral Partners scored zoning approval this year for a 20-story, 418-unit apartment project in Riviera Beach, near the Port of Palm Beach.

properties.name: Polo West Golf Course, Wellington
properties.caption: This year, BH Group closed on its nearly $21 million of the closed Polo West Golf Course in Wellington, after suing seller Glenn Straub to force the trade of the 150.5-acre development site. Straub's affiliate allegedly had backed out of the deal, BH Group claimed in its complaint. The suit settled. BH Group is yet to reveal its redevelopment plan.

properties.name: Naples ALF
properties.caption: This is the third assisted-living facility purchase by the BH Group and Gold Standard of Care partnership. In October, the pair bought this center near Naples with 133 assisted-living units and 40 skilled nursing rooms at a 63 percent discount from its 2021 price. The seller was an entity tied to Benjamin Berkowitz and Yosef Meystel of embattled assisted-living operator Aperion Care.

properties.name: Olana Naples
properties.caption: BH Group is seizing on the booming Naples luxury market. BH and Kolter Group are developing the 12-unit waterfront Olana condo building, where homes will span 10,000 square feet. In September, the developers scored a $197 million construction loan.

properties.name: Ritz-Carlton Residences Palm Coast
properties.caption: BH Group has expanded its reach to Northeast Florida. North of Daytona Beach, BH has approvals for a pair of 64-unit condo buildings south of the Tuscany condo in Hammock Dunes. The Ritz-Carlton development is the last piece of the larger Hammock Dunes development.
